messages.火傷編成で、他の人格が保つ火傷回数の上に多コインで火傷威力を積み、対象の火傷6以: A Blunt Identity for Burn teams that stacks Burn Potency through multiple Coins while allies maintain Count, then gains bonuses against targets with at least 6 Burn. On the bench, Rushing Heart also improves allies' damage.
messages.火傷6以上で強化: S1「一点突き」・S2「一網打尽」は対象の火傷6以上でコイン: **Bonuses at 6+ Burn**: S1 Single-point Stab and S2 Rush Down gain +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Burn, and S3 Perfected Palm Strike deals +10% damage. On Coin Ⅲ hit, S2 grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn if the target has at least 6 Burn.
messages.火傷威力の付与: 各コインで火傷1を付与し、S2のⅢコイン・S3のⅣコインは的中: **Inflicting Burn Potency**: Each Coin inflicts 1 Burn, and Coin Ⅲ of S2 and Coin Ⅳ of S3 inflict 3 Burn on hit. The effect text has no mention of increasing Burn Count (whether S1's "inflict 1 Burn" is Potency or Count cannot be determined from the wording).
messages.バトルパッシブ「発火」(怠惰×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): スキルの3つ目以降の: **Combat passive — Ignition (3 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Inflicts 1 Burn on hits from the third and later Coins of a skill. With this, landing all of S2's Coins reaches 6 Burn (1+1+3+1).
messages.サポートパッシブ「ひた走る心」(怠惰×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 編成中かつ戦: **Support passive — Rushing Heart (5 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in the team but not participating in battle, Coins after the third of the 1 slowest ally deal +30% damage.
messages.マッチ威力が低い: S1は最大8、S2は最大11、S3は最大12。: **Low Clash Power**: S1 tops out at 8, S2 at 11, and S3 at 12.
messages.自分では火傷回数を足せないため、火傷回数を付与する人格と組んで火傷を保つ。S2・: He cannot add Burn Count himself, so pair him with Identities who inflict Burn Count to keep Burn going. Bring the target's Burn to 6 or more with S2 and S3, then attack with the bonuses on S1–S3. His Clash Power caps are low, so prepare for strong attacks with E.G.O. When he is not deployed, make use of Rushing Heart in teams with slow allies who have multi-Coin skills.
